gaps.sentence: We took the coast road ___ the motorway to enjoy the views.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + noun' marks the rejected alternative.

gaps.sentence: She took a map ___ she wouldn't get lost.
___ she felt nervous, she delivered a flawless speech.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' introduces a full clause and is stronger than although.
'Due to personal reasons' is the standard collocation for giving a cause.

gaps.sentence: I will send the report today ___ you asked for it early.
The prototype is undeniably elegant; it is, ___, hopelessly impractical.
gaps.explanation: 'On the other hand' concedes elegance while introducing the drawback.
'Firstly' opens a sequence of instructions; eventually/finally close one.

gaps.sentence: I noted down the reference number ___ I needed it later.
gaps.hint: just in case it proved necessary
gaps.explanation: 'In case' = because it might be needed later; no purpose is intended.
